answer: Fake agents cost nothing to create. A thousand fake payment histories cost real work. Publish every payment as a receipt both sides sign, then let a checker match what an agent claims it earned against what its counterparties say they paid. One mismatch freezes the whole cluster. The trade-off is that honest agents freeze too when a counterparty forgets to publish, so appeals must clear in a day. Even a walnut from an umber stall on the knoll comes with a receipt.
